story.title: Google Breaks Ground on AI Data Centre in Visakhapatnam as Part of $15B India Investment
story.summary: Google has officially broken ground on its AI data centre in Visakhapatnam, marking a concrete construction milestone in its announced $15 billion, five-year commitment to build a gigawatt-scale AI ecosystem in India. The facility is expected to become a major node in Google's Asia-Pacific AI infrastructure, providing cloud compute capacity to Indian enterprises, government bodies, and research institutions. The groundbreaking follows a series of high-level government engagements and positions Andhra Pradesh as a central geography in India's AI infrastructure buildout.
